# CR-008 — Data contracts + transport (outbound-only, two legs) / สัญญาข้อมูลและช่องทางรับส่ง

**Status:** approved (Boss, 2026-08-09) · **Mode:** DDD
**Contract:** `docs/contracts/smartgift-zuri-transport-v1.md` — **FROZEN before this code was written** (contract-first is a requirement of this CR, not a nicety)
**Plan ref:** `implementation-plan-2026-08-09.md` §5 (ZUMP01 Phase 3) · **Design ref:** `smart-crm-design-2026-08-08.md` §2, §7

## Problem / ปัญหา

SmartGift's analytical plane (local DuckDB + GenesisBlockDB) and Zuri (cloud, operational) have no
way to exchange data. The design's central architectural constraint is that **the local machine is
not reachable from the internet** — no inbound port, no tunnel — so the only workable shape is:
local pulls events down, local pushes aggregates up, and Zuri never initiates anything.
เครื่อง local เข้าถึงจากอินเทอร์เน็ตไม่ได้ ช่องทางเดียวที่ใช้ได้คือ local ดึงลง / local ส่งขึ้น — Zuri ห้ามเรียกกลับ

CR-003 already emits `consent.updated` and `customer.erased` into `ExportEvent`, but nothing reads
them, nothing else emits, and there is no machine authentication at all (every route is
session-based; the mobile Bearer path is per-employee, not per-machine).

## Change / การแก้

| # | Piece | Detail |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Machine auth** — `TenantApiKey` model + `src/lib/apiKeyAuth.js` | New model: `id` · `tenantId` · `name` · `keyHash` (SHA-256, `@unique`) · `prefix` (first 12 chars, for display/identification) · `scopes String[]` · `lastUsedAt` · `revokedAt` · `createdAt` · `createdById`. **The raw key is never stored.** `withApiKey(handler, { scope })` reads `Authorization: Bearer <key>`, hashes, looks the key up, rejects revoked (`401`) / wrong scope (`403`), resolves `tenantId` **from the key only** (a `tenantId` in the request is ignored — contract §2), stamps `lastUsedAt` (fire-and-forget), and opens the AsyncLocalStorage tenant context so the Prisma `$extends` guard is armed exactly as `withAuth` does. |
| 2 | **Key minting** — `scripts/onboard/tenant-api-key.mjs` (new) | Follows CR-004's script conventions: `--slug <tenant> --name <label> --scopes export:read,import:write`, prints the raw key **once** to stdout and never again (only the hash is persisted), `--revoke <prefix>` to revoke. No admin UI and no API for key creation in this CR — a mint endpoint is a credential-issuing surface and deserves its own review. |
| 3 | **`GET /api/export/events`** | Cursor pagination per contract §3: order `(createdAt, eventId)`, cursor `createdAt|eventId`, `limit` default 100 clamped to 1000, response `{ events, nextCursor, hasMore }`. Scope `export:read`. Tenant comes from the key. Never returns another tenant's rows (repo query is explicitly scoped **and** the ALS guard is armed). |
| 4 | **`GET /api/export/events/counts`** | `?from=&to=` (ISO dates, max 31-day window) → `{ counts: [{ date, type, count }] }` via `groupBy`. This is what makes the local side's daily reconciliation possible — without it a lost event is invisible. |
| 5 | **`POST /api/import/snapshots`** | Body `{ kind, asOf, payload }`, `kind ∈ metrics | approved_prices | segment_candidates`. New model `ImportSnapshot`: `id` · `tenantId` · `kind` · `asOf` · `payload Json` · `receivedAt` · `@@index([tenantId, kind, asOf])`. `asOf` mandatory (`400` without it). Scope `import:write`. History retained; readers take the newest per kind. |
| 6 | **PII rejection at the boundary** — `src/lib/piiGuard.js` (new) | Recursive key scan of any imported payload: rejects `name`, `firstName`, `lastName`, `displayName`, `phone*`, `email`, `address*`, `taxId`, `lineId`, `facebookId`, `companyName` (case-insensitive, any depth, inside arrays) → `400 PII_FORBIDDEN` naming the offending path. Also rejects any string value that parses as a URL (contract §1: no callbacks may enter). The local exporter lints before sending; this is the **deliberately redundant** second gate, because a PII leak here is unrecoverable. |
| 7 | **Event emission** | A shared `emitExportEvent(client, { tenantId, type, payload })` helper (works inside a transaction or standalone, reused by CR-003's existing emitters). Wire the types the contract promises: `stage.changed` (in `customerRepo.transitionStage`), `quote.created` / `quote.sent` / `quote.outcome` (in `quoteRepo`), `message.received` (LINE webhook message path). Payloads carry **ids/enums/timestamps only** — e.g. `stage.changed` = `{ customerId, from, to, changedBy, at }`, `message.received` = `{ conversationId, customerId, direction, at }` and **never the message text**. |
| 8 | **Retention** | `ExportEvent` rows older than **30 days** are pruned by the existing `workers/audit-cleanup` worker (extend it; do not add a new worker). The contract states the window, so the local side knows a stale cursor means permanent loss. Prune count is logged. |
| 9 | **Tests** | `apiKeyAuth`: unknown/revoked key → 401, wrong scope → 403, valid key resolves the right tenant, a `tenantId` in the request cannot override it, `lastUsedAt` failure never breaks the request. Export events: cursor paging is stable across equal timestamps, `hasMore`/`nextCursor` correctness, tenant isolation (tenant A's key never sees tenant B's rows), limit clamping. Counts: grouping + window cap. Import: missing `asOf` → 400, unknown kind → 400, oversized → 413, **PII at depth/in arrays → 400 with the path**, URL value → 400. `piiGuard` unit table. Emission: each emitter writes exactly one event with a PII-free payload (assert exact key sets, as CR-003 does). Retention prune deletes only rows past the window. |

## Acceptance Criteria / เกณฑ์ยอมรับ

- **AC1 (the one that matters)** No endpoint added by this CR accepts a URL, host, port or callback,
  and none initiates an outbound connection to a caller-supplied destination. Zuri cannot reach the
  local machine by any path this CR introduces. Asserted by test **and** by review.
- **AC2** A request's tenant is determined solely by its API key; a `tenantId` supplied in query or
  body is ignored. Tenant A's key returns zero rows belonging to tenant B.
- **AC3** Event pulling is resumable and lossless: paging with the returned cursor visits every
  event exactly once in `(createdAt, eventId)` order, including rows sharing a timestamp, and
  re-pulling the same cursor is idempotent.
- **AC4** `GET /export/events/counts` returns per-day per-type counts matching what the events
  endpoint would serve for the same window (this is the reconciliation guarantee).
- **AC5** Any imported payload containing a PII-shaped key at any depth is rejected `400
  PII_FORBIDDEN`; no such payload is ever persisted.
- **AC6** Every emitted event payload contains ids/enums/timestamps only — asserted by exact key
  set, per event type. `message.received` never carries message text.
- **AC7** `npm run lint` + targeted vitest + `npm run test:scripts` green; `npx prisma validate` passes.

## Out of scope / นอกขอบเขต

- The **local side** (`zuri_pull.py`, exporters, PII-lint, reconciliation job) — that is SGMP01
  work in the SmartGift repo, not this CR. This CR delivers only Zuri's half of the contract.
- Dashboard tiles that read the snapshots (CR-010) — snapshots land in the table and wait.
- An API-key admin UI or a mint endpoint (credential-issuing surface; own CR).
- Backfilling `ExportEvent` for history that predates the emitters.
- Rate limiting per key (contract §6 reserves `429`; the platform limiter is a separate concern) —
  documented as reserved, not implemented here.

## Rollout / การปล่อย

Two additive models, no change to existing tables. Nothing changes behaviour until a key is minted
and the local side starts calling. Order: deploy → mint the key locally
(`scripts/onboard/tenant-api-key.mjs`) → local puller starts with no cursor → verify daily counts
match for **7 consecutive days** before any dashboard depends on the feed (gate G3 in the plan).
